艾米与售票处的计划(Amy and the the ticket office: 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:艾米与山姆的经历和小计划。
Amy plays badminton with Sam every Thursday. Sam's birthday is in October. There are always many people at the ticket office. In fact, excuse me, sir, is this seat taken?
Amy learned a lot about English. Both of them like rice and juice. Amy wants to be a cook in the future. She bought a green savoy cabbage for the winter soup.
Last Thursday, Amy and Sam went to the airport. Amy thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was snowy that day. What's more, an all-inclusive deal covers meals.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the airport by bike. Amy hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Life is full of small surprises.
